text:
mike: AE here. Customer (APAC bank) asks for a 90-day on‑prem pilot in their DC. They want the first 30 days completely waived, then a reduced platform fee for the remaining 60 days (they suggested 25% of list). They also want the pilot to count toward an optional 12‑month committed prod contract (if converted) such that pilot months count for first 3 months of the commit. Additionally they require priority support during pilot, a dedicated pool, and geo‑DR across two regions. Need quote + redlineable terms by COB Friday. @sara can we get an approach?

sara: Short answer: POC <=90d is OK but 30d full waiver is outside standard. Our usual play: 14 days free trial, then discounted POC rate. We can approve deeper discounts with Deal Desk. For dedicated pool + DR, expect a regional premium (adds to platform fee). We need peak qps or tokens/sec to size the pool and estimate incremental cost. Also note: pilot billed to one entity then prod billed to another will require billing/legal review.

lucas: Technical ops notes: DR as active‑passive across regions will require double capacity or cross‑region standby; plan for ~1.6x capacity multiplier for failover. Dedicated pool + DR typically adds ~25–35% to platform fee. Priority support during pilot: we can temporarily enable Gold support if commit is signed within X days; otherwise Gold reverts to standard charge (+20%). HSM/KMS onboarding also has a one‑time network/setup charge.

mike: Customer is pushing hard for 30d full waiver and separate billing (pilot billed to a UK entity, prod to a Singapore entity). They insist pilot value is for internal validation and budget approvals. If possible we'd like a letter‑of‑goodwill approach rather than retrobilling.

dealdesk-bot: Deal Desk ticket created: DD-4599 "30d POC waiver + split billing entities". Assigned to @sara. Link: https://dealdesk.redwood.internal/DD-4599

legal: Split billing is allowed but requires an MSA with a schedule listing both bill‑to entities and either (a) parent company guarantee or (b) inter‑company MSA signature. That adds 3–5 business days to legal review. Also flag: APAC export controls — confirm data residency requirements and whether HSM keys will be stored in EU/SG.

sara: Proposed workable offers to speed closure:
  1) Promo A (fast path): 30d full waiver capped at $15k value; customer must sign the 12mo commit within 45 days after pilot end to keep the waiver. If they don't sign, we bill the waived amount retroactively. Dedicated pool + DR priced separately.
  2) Promo B (conservative): 14d free + remaining 76d at 50% platform fee capped at $20k; conversion credit: actual POC payments applied to first 3 months of prod platform fee. Billing entity split accepted but requires legal timeline caveat.
Which path do you want AE to present?

mike: I'll present Promo A (30d cap $15k, retrobill if no commit) and note the legal timing on billing split. I'll ask for traffic estimates today. Need DD reply by EOD so I can get the signed SOW to the customer on Friday.

sara: Acknowledged, escalating DD-4599 to execs for morning sign-off. Tagging finance + legal.

dealdesk-bot: DD-4599 status updated: escalated to Exec Review.

(lucas reacted with :rocket:)
